text.title: Go Concurrency Patterns (Worker Pool, Fan-Out/Fan-In, errgroup, Pipeline) Procedure
text.summary: 5-step procedure to produce a Go Concurrency Patterns (Worker Pool, Fan-Out/Fan-In, errgroup, Pipeline) artefact from typed inputs.

step.name: gather
step.action: Confirm every prerequisite is present and recent. Refuse to proceed if any are missing.
step.output: inputs.json with typed entries for each prerequisite
step.decision-gate: Any prerequisite missing - exit with reason; do not synthesize.

step.name: analyse
step.action: Parse + classify each input against the core rules. Tag known vs unknown values. Compute any derived metric the contract requires.

step.name: draft
step.action: Compose draft decision + rationale referencing at least one input by name. Apply allowed-transformations from 02-output-contract.xml.

step.name: self-check
step.action: Run the self-check checklist from 02-output-contract.xml. Match against forbidden patterns and the failure modes in 03-failure-modes.xml. If any hit, fix and re-check.
step.decision-gate: If any forbidden pattern still matches after one fix attempt - escalate to human.

step.name: emit
step.action: Set artefact_id with prefix `gocp-`, version=1.0.0 (or bump if updating an existing record), last_reviewed=today. Validate against templates/go-concurrency-patterns.json. Emit.
step.output: final artefact + status flag for owner review

section.title: Implementation sub-procedure (expands steps 2 and 3 when the artefact ships real code)

step.name: sketch-workload
step.input: Producer rate + consumer cost + latency budget.
step.action: Estimate workload characteristics; identify the parallelism opportunity and classify it CPU-bound vs IO-bound vs streaming vs fail-fast.

step.name: size-the-pool
step.action: Pick pool size from the downstream ceiling (DB connections, HTTP target rate). CPU-bound: `runtime.NumCPU()`. IO-bound: a multiple of it.

step.name: pick-pipeline-shape
step.action: Default to fan-out/fan-in: producer → bounded pool → fan-in collector. A bespoke shape requires an ADR.

step.name: plumb-cancellation
step.action: Pass `ctx` through every goroutine; each checks `ctx.Done()` in its loop; coordinate with `errgroup.WithContext`.
step.decision-gate: If cancellation cannot be wired (legacy API), fork a derived context with a timeout as the fallback and record it.

step.name: audit-for-leaks
step.action: Run a pprof goroutine profile under load; confirm steady-state count. Growth means a leak. Pair with the `goleak.VerifyNone(t)` test.

list.item: Named owner has acknowledged the artefact
